business.headline: First versions people can use.
business.lede: MVPs, backends and AI features for startups and tech teams. Omnibus is one our team built.

case.label: The problem
case.body: Two people see the same seat free and both press book.

case.label: How it is built
case.body: One short transaction takes a PostgreSQL lock on that seat before checking it.

case.label: The result
case.body: The second booking is refused on the spot. Target: zero double bookings.
